steps: Open Amex's official page https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/business/credit-cards/blue-business-cash/42732/ and confirm the $250-after-$3,000 welcome offer is still showing.
Complete the business application (sole proprietorship is eligible); Amex runs a hard inquiry on your personal credit when you apply.
If approved, spend $3,000 on eligible business purchases you were already planning within the first 3 months — gift cards, prepaid reloads, and person-to-person payments do NOT count.
Pay the balance in full every month — carrying a balance at 16.74%–28.49% variable APR destroys the bonus.
The $250 statement credit posts to your billing statement within 8–12 weeks of hitting the threshold.
timing: Application takes 20–40 min active; then spend $3,000 in already-planned business purchases within 3 months; $250 statement credit posts 8–12 weeks after the threshold.
